line.name: Perdomo Legacy Father and Son
line.description: A limited collaboration: Nick Perdomo Jr. blended the Shade Grown wrapper version, his son Nick Perdomo III blended the Maduro version, and they co-developed the Connecticut version. Made from 2011-2016-harvest tobacco. First previewed May 2026 at Two Guys Cigars (NH), wider Q4 2026 shipping. Limited to 50-count chests, $15 MSRP/cigar, released roughly once or twice a year rather than as standing production.
line.wrapper: Connecticut, Maduro, or Shade Grown (3 editions, see vitolas)

vitolas.name: Gran Figurado Connecticut
vitolas.notes: Box-pressed gran figurado (perfecto): 6 inches long, 48 ring gauge at foot, 60 at belly, 52 at head.
